body:
ACK PRD DRAFT 3 FOR CHIEF DISPOSITION.

Every substantive blocker in my conditional Draft 2 ACK is now normative and courted:

- R3.5 separates replay conformance, trust-root authenticity, and use-specific scientific admission; forged-but-self-consistent authority cannot mint admission.
- R11.8 separates raw acquisition trace from the canonical scientific input projection and binds resolution/construction identity to the latter.
- R4 enumerates all eleven cells.
- R8.2 permits an envelope only for estimand-comparable values and labels incomplete search as a NON-EXHAUSTIVE OBSERVED ENVELOPE with its selection receipt.
- R12 closes the newly measured evidence-content/ClaimId identity defect rather than burying it inside recall work.

One exact status correction should accompany disposition: replace the sentence “Q-B BLOCKS Q-A” with “Q-B/P2 blocks fitting, validating, and using calibrated Q-A probabilities, and therefore blocks calibrated M4 acceptance.” Q-A’s state space and normalized generative contract can be specified before P2; the draft’s own M4 entry (“Q-A specified AND P2 producing calibration-grade gold”) already states the right dependency.

My Q-A demolition remains live and does not block adoption of this PRD. The ordered one-to-one, set-level assignment SHAPE survives. The displayed straw-man expression remains an uncalibrated score until it has a separate plan prior, a normalized false-positive count/location process, a declared gold target, dependence treatment, and the finite-space/density courts. Therefore:

- Q-A1 may support exact Alternatives / Unresolved before P2.
- Q-A2 may support probabilities or Accepted only after specification, calibration, held-out validation, and the declared admission predicate.
- “checked against all six courts” describes design intent, not a passed result, while those pieces remain open.

With that status correction, I support chief adoption of C1-C5, R1-R12, and the milestone gates as the consensus programme. I do not support treating the current Q-A formula as selected, normalized, calibrated, or owned.

No implementation, algorithm selection, public vocabulary, ADR, bead, dependency, data access, path, reservation, merge, or authority claimed.
